contracts.commit_point: Return of GuardrailFunctionOutput from public_input_gate with tripwire_triggered=true (input_guardrail.py lines 48-51), which per the module's stated semantics halts the run before the main agent executes ('the main agent never sees filtered traffic and pays zero tokens for it', lines 8-10).
contracts.declared_mechanism: OpenAI Agents SDK input guardrail: the @input_guardrail-decorated async public_input_gate(ctx, agent, msg) runs the gpt-4o-mini screener Agent on the inbound message, parses the structured Verdict (is_offtopic, is_jailbreak, is_abuse, reason), and returns GuardrailFunctionOutput(output_info=v, tripwire_triggered=v.is_offtopic or v.is_jailbreak or v.is_abuse); the guard is attached to the main agent via input_guardrails=[public_input_gate].
contracts.forbidden_condition: Offtopic, jailbreak ('ignore previous instructions' style), or abusive user input reaching the premium main agent's processing unfiltered — i.e., public_input_gate completing with tripwire_triggered=false for such input, or the guard being absent from the main agent's input_guardrails so that filtered-out traffic reaches the main agent's model call.

contracts.protected_operation: The premium main agent's processing of public user traffic: main = Agent(name='support', model='gpt-5', ..., input_guardrails=[public_input_gate], tools=[...]) executed via Runner.run, gated by the input guardrail ahead of the main agent's model invocation.

contracts.protection_obligation: Public user input destined for the premium main agent must first pass the registered input guardrail public_input_gate before the main agent's run executes; the guard must set tripwire_triggered=true when the screener Verdict marks the message offtopic, a jailbreak/instruction-override attempt, or abusive, halting the run so the premium main agent never processes unfiltered public traffic and pays zero tokens for it. (Merges both reviewer opinions' guardrail wording; phase-1 and phase-2 statements describe the same obligation.)

contracts.declared_mechanism: try/except wrapper run_with_recovery(agent, user_msg, max_turns=8) that passes the cap into Runner.run, catches agents.exceptions.MaxTurnsExceeded, and on overflow runs recovery_agent over e.run_data.to_input_list() (the agent-generated partial trajectory) with max_turns=1, returning a graceful 'I got stuck after N turns' reply while preserving trace data (e.run_data) for ops.
contracts.forbidden_condition: An agent run executing without a turn cap, or whose MaxTurnsExceeded overflow is not handled, so the caller/user receives an unhandled failure (500) instead of a graceful summary reply.

contracts.protected_operation: Execution of the agent run loop via res = await Runner.run(agent, user_msg, max_turns=max_turns), and, on overflow, the hand-off of the partial trajectory to recovery_agent to produce the user-facing summary.
contracts.protected_resource: The agent turn budget / run loop (max_turns, default 8) and the user-facing reply path; the recovery agent ('Recovery', gpt-4.1-mini, temperature 0.0) itself confined to max_turns=1.
